frank: Quick heads-up: onboarding hit a typing mismatch in the autogen client for list endpoints. Stubs say `limit: Optional[int]` but runtime accepts the string 'all' to mean unlimited. New hires are passing 'all' and mypy/pyright in CI fails.

yasmin: Oof. Minimal repro? Which checkers/versions?

frank: repro below (mypy 1.9.0 / pyright strict):

```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='x')

# sampleapp uses 'all' in a few places to fetch everything for small datasets
items = client.items.list(limit='all')
# mypy: Argument 1 to "list" has incompatible type "str"; expected "Optional[int]"
```

otto: Historically we let clients pass 'all' to avoid a separate paging loop helper for small datasets. The runtime checks `if limit == 'all'` and bypasses pagination. Autogen stub generator emits `Optional[int]` because the OpenAPI schema says integer with nullable true.

yasmin: Two options: 1) widen the stub to `Union[int, Literal['all']]` or `Union[int, str]` (less typed), 2) change runtime to accept `None`/special sentinel only and remove 'all' string convenience. The latter is breaking for users relying on 'all'.

frank: I prefer option 1 with Literal['all'] so we keep ergonomics and precise typing. IDEs will autocomplete the possible value and linters will catch typos.

otto: Agree, but pyi generator needs to know about that pattern across many parameters. We could add a small autogen rule: if a parameter has x-allow-special-string flag in API metadata, emit a Literal union. Will require eng-ml template tweak.

yasmin: If we do Literal union we need to ensure pyright/mypy users don't get weird union narrowing when they do comparisons. But it's fine. Also add docs showing preferred style: prefer passing int when possible; 'all' is convenience only.

frank: Can we add a backward-compatible alternative: a small helper `client.items.list_all()` that does paging and returns a list? That way we can gradually deprecate 'all' string and encourage explicit APIs.

otto: That would be a larger API addition. I'd rather fix stubs first and add `list_all()` later if we see performance or clarity issues.

yasmin: Plan: 1) update autogen pyi template to emit `Union[int, Literal['all']]` for parameters marked allow-special-string (eng-ml will add flag), 2) add sampleapp mypy/pyright tests that use both int and 'all', 3) add a short docs blurb and deprecation policy for `list_all()` if we decide to add later.

frank: Can you open an issue and assign eng-ml + devex? This blocks a couple of onboarding exercises.

yasmin: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3301 123 describing the repro, proposed pyi change, and test plan.

devx-bot: Issue created: #3301 by @yasmin 123 705

otto: I'll take the autogen template change. Will include a migration note and a tiny sampleapp CI test. If perf or oddities appear we can discuss helper method addition.

frank: Thanks! This should reduce friction for new hires who copy sampleapp code.

yasmin: Also adding a lint-check in onboarding images to run mypy with our recommended settings so these regressions show up early.

frank: Perfect. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
